## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew assembleDebug lintDebug` passes.
- [ ] I tested the change on an Android TV / Google TV device or emulator.
- [ ] I added no dependency, GitHub Action or vendored file. If I did, an approved issue is linked, and the checksums are updated.
- [ ] No analytics, remote configuration, native library or run-time code download.
- [ ] No tokens, account data or personal data in the code, logs or screenshots.
- [ ] I updated the documentation (README, AGENTS.md) for a change that users or contributors can see. Instructions use ASD-STE100.
